NARRATIVE_STORE_EGYPT_PINATA_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{SAY}It will take some gems to fix this. Take these.
NARRATIVE_STORE_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{PLAYFUL}Nice work! Hey Penny, what does this button do?
NARRATIVE_STORE_INTRO_2: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{EXCITED}Most interesting, there's special items in there!
NARRATIVE_STORE_MORE_GEMS_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{TIRED}Hopefully these universe-crossing zombie heads will leave us be now.
NARRATIVE_STORE_OPEN_PINATAS_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{SAY}There's another timey-wimey anomaly thing in the store! Let's go get rid of it!
NARRATIVE_TUMBLEWEED_EQ_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Tumbleweeds anywhere to send them rolling down the lane at zombies.
NARRATIVE_TURKEYPULT_EQ_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Turkey-pults to lob tofu turkeys at zombies. Plant 2 or more per row to overwhelm zombies!
NARRATIVE_TUTORIAL_PLANTLEVELS_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}I sure hope no Buckethead Zombie attacks that poor lil' Peashooter!
NARRATIVE_TUTORIAL_PLANTLEVELS_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}At its current level, it is even stronger than a regular Repeater.
NARRATIVE_ULTOMATO_EQ_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Plant Ultomatos on top of themselves to mutate them up from green to yellow to red!
NARRATIVE_UNIVERSE_INTRO_TUTORIAL_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{EXCITED}Good news! That Pirate Key went flooey, and now we have a map to my taco!
NARRATIVE_UNIVERSE_INTRO_TUTORIAL_4: {SAY:winnieicon}We are outside of time. Between Ancient Egypt and the Pirate Seas.
NARRATIVE_UNIVERSE_INTRO_TUTORIAL_6: {SAY:winnieicon}We must brave the Pirate Seas, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_UNIVERSE_INTRO_TUTORIAL_7: {SAY:crazydaveicon}I'll brave ANYTHING for taco treasure! Let's go!
NARRATIVE_VASEBREAKER_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}A lawn of vases is like a box of chocolates.
NARRATIVE_VASEBREAKER_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}Some are awesome! Others taste downright ugly!
NARRATIVE_VASEBREAKER_INTRO_3: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}But all vases are much harder on your teeth!
NARRATIVE_VASEBREAKER_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Be careful with how fast you break vases.
NARRATIVE_VASEBREAKER_INTRO_5: {EXCITED:winnie}You might end up with more ugly than you can handle.
NARRATIVE_VETERAN_WARNING_10: {SAY:winnie}It is not necessary to shout, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_VETERAN_WARNING_3: {SAY:crazydave}Should we mention these post-Zomboss nodes are REALLY difficult?
NARRATIVE_VETERAN_WARNING_4: {SAY:crazydave}And that it would be CRAAAA-ZY to try them without leveled-up plants?
NARRATIVE_VETERAN_WARNING_8: {SAY:crazydave}YOU SHOULD GET SOME PLANTS UP TO AT LEAST LEVEL 5 TO BEAT THEM!!!
NARRATIVE_WINTERMINT_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Power Mints are powerful plants you can acquire with gems.
NARRATIVE_WINTERMINT_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}They provide a big boost to plants in their family.
NARRATIVE_WINTERMINT_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}The Winter-mint family comprises chilling and freezing plants.
NARRATIVE_YETI_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:winnieicon}{PLAYFUL}My Penny sense has detected a rare and curious lunch box.
NARRATIVE_YETI_INTRO_2: {NPC_ENTER:crazydaveicon}{PLAYFUL}I smell a Yeti! Let's go after him!
NARRATIVE_ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_SPEE: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}Your Sunflower will grow up too, but it takes awhile.
{PLAYFUL:winnie}Try some more Gems to speed her up!
NARRATIVE_ZEN_GARDEN_INTRO_TUTORIAL_WELC: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{EXCITED}Zen Garden isn't just for growing Marigolds.
{EXCITED:crazydave}You can also grow mega powerful boosted plants!
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}But boosted plants only last for a single level!
NARRATIVE_ZEN_GARDEN_MARIGOLD_TUTORIAL_S: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}If you wait a while, your Marigold will grow.
{PLAYFUL:winnie}But you can speed up the process with Gems!
NARRATIVE_ZEN_GARDEN_MARIGOLD_TUTORIAL_W: {EXCITED:crazydave}Maybe if you water it, you'll get coins?
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}At least, I think that's how it works.
NARRATIVE_ZOMBERT_TEST_2: {SAY:zombert}Chat... hue hue hue... I'm in the game. Hue hue hue.
NARRATIVE_ZOMBERT_TEST_3: {SAY:zombert}Dude... I'm gonna own these freaks. Hue hue hue...
NARRATIVE_ZOMBERT_TEST_4: {SAY:zombert}Chat... what should I do to them...
NARRATIVE_ZOMBERT_TEST_6: {SAY:zombert}Chat has chosen... epic own time... hue hue hue... you guys stink. Hue hue hue hue hue...

NIGHTCAP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}avoids most zombie attacks
{FLAVOR}Nightcap's always had a keen sense for justice, back from when she was a tiny spore watching late-night ninja movies instead of concentrating on her mycology homework.
NIGHTCAP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Nightcap shoots piercing poisonous stars down the lane and withdraws into a toxic stealth mode when zombies get too close.
NIGHTSHADE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hurls and regrows leaves when powered

{FLAVOR}For Nightshade, smacking is a duty and a privilege. He comes from a long line of ardent smackers, and his family counts three kings, four ambassadors and a president as among those proudly slapped around.
NIGHTSHADE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Nightshades are shadow plants that smack zombies with slappy leaves.
NOCTARINE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single-use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Noctarine gas can power shadow plants
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Noctarine gas multiplies damage dealt by other shadow plants to zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}powered Noctarine gas slows zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}powered Noctarine gas can create exploding zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can be planted on top of other plants

{FLAVOR}For a plant churning with internal gases, Noctarine's opinions are shockingly conventional. "Jaws is a good movie," he says. Like, NO KIDDING, Noctarine!
NOCTARINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Noctarines are shadow plants that explode and create clouds of damaging gas.
NOTIFICATION_CHANNEL_QUESTS_DESCRIPTION: Turn on Travel Log Quest notifications
NOT_ENOUGH_SPROUTS: No more sprouts. Play levels to find more!
OFFERWALL_OUT_OF_ADS_DESCRIPTION: We are unable to play an ad at this time. Please try again later.
OFFLINE_FACEBOOK_LOGIN_BODY: Please connect to a network in order to log in to Facebook.
OLIVEPIT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}takes 30 seconds to swallow trapped zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}spits out zombie-slowing olive oil

{FLAVOR}You know that old saying, "even zombies never fall into the same pit twice?" Well he can tell you from experience that they do. Quite often. It's a bit embarrassing really.
OLIVEPIT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Olive Pits drill into the ground and wait to consume zombies foolish enough to walk over them.
OLIVEPIT_TOOLTIP: Spits out slowing oil and swallows zombies that walk over it
OUT_OF_CONTENT_HEADER: You need to download assets for this level.
PACKET_LAST_STAND_LOCKED: This plant cannot be planted during Last Stand setup.
PARSNIP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}plant is lost after charging attack

{FLAVOR}"Snip!" says Parsnip. "Snip snip snip! If it wasn't for my scrapbook, my coupons, and snipping zombies to death, I just don't know what I'd do with myself!"
PARSNIP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Parsnips snip at zombies, then charge down the lane at the last moment.
PARSNIP_TOOLTIP: Snips zombies, then charges down lane
PATCH_VERIFICATION_FAILED: Downloaded content may have been corrupted. Updated content will need to be downloaded again.
PEANUT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}attack slows down when at half health

{FLAVOR}Pea-nut knows that some folks have an aversion to him. He tries to be sensitive to their concerns and give them the space they need. Still, he can't help but miss the good old days – back when he was the most popular nut around.
PEANUT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Pea-nuts can shoot peas and block zombies.
PEAPOD_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}increases rate of fire with multiple plantings

{FLAVOR}Having studied Quantum Spatial Mechanics in Clown College, Pea Pod has been amusing families of all ages.
PEAPOD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Pea Pods can be planted in the same space for up to 5 times the destruction.
PEAPOD_PLANTFOOD: Monstrous Peashooter head emerges and shoots 5 giant peas.
PEAPOD_TOOLTIP: Plant multiple times on the same spot to multiply damage
PEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}"What is it like being famous?" asked the Peashooter while sipping his bottled water, "I can't talk right now, I'm finishing my merchandising deal. Hold my fir coat."
PEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Peashooters are your first line of defense. They shoot peas at attacking zombies.
PEASHOOTER_PLANTFOOD: Fires off a stream of peas, adding up to a lot of damage.
PENNY_SHIELD_DESCRIPTION: Creates a {HEALTH} health shield every {TIME} seconds!
PENNY_SHIELD_MULTIPLE_DESCRIPTION: Creates {NUMBER} shields with {HEALTH} health every {TIME} seconds!
PEPPERMINT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Pepper-mint Family Plants:
{STAT}Fire Peashooter
{STAT}Ghost Pepper
{STAT}Hot Date
{STAT}Hot Potato
{STAT}Jack-O-Lantern
{STAT}Jalapeno
{STAT}Lava Guava
{STAT}Pepper-pult
{STAT}Pyre Vine
{STAT}Snapdragon
{STAT}Torchwood
{STAT}Wasabi Whip

{FLAVOR}Pepper-mint likes heat. He's down with flames, he digs on fire, he's a total madman for oxidization and ignition. If he sees you rubbing two sticks together, he'll come over and ask about it. He can't help himself."
PEPPERMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Pepper-mints set off lane-wide bursts of flame when planted and provide a temporary boost to all Pepper-mint Family plants on the lawn.
PEPPERPULT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}immune to frost
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}warms nearby plants

{FLAVOR}Some say Pepper-pult is a hot head. Some find his fiery disposition off-putting. But the truth is, he's just very focused and determined. He loves what he does. He appreciates everything he has. "I came from the weedy side of the lawn," Pepper-pult explains. "I worked hard to pull myself up by my roots. I'm a self-made pepper and I don't take a single thing for granted."
PEPPERPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Pepper-pults lob flaming peppers at zombies and keep nearby plants warm.
PEPPERPULT_PLANTFOOD: Lobs massive explosive peppers at random targets on the lawn, while melting nearby ice.
PEPPERPULT_TOOLTIP: Lobs flaming peppers at zombies and warms nearby plants
PERFUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}affects all dinosaurs in a lane

{FLAVOR}Perfume-shrooms emit a pure, concentrated mist of aerosolized love.
PERFUMESHROOM_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Perfume-shrooms enchant dinosaurs and charm them into working against the zombies.
PERK_SELECTION_JALAPENO_PLANTS_LOST_WARN: Exploding a Jalapeno counts as losing a plant. Do you still wish to use this perk?
PERK_SELECTION_MINE_PLANTS_LOST_WARNING: Exploding a Potato Mine counts as losing a plant. Do you still wish to use this perk?
PERK_SELECTION_NO_PERKS_WARNING:
You haven't selected a FREE Perk!
Are you sure you want to continue?
PERM_LAWN_MOWER_TUTORIAL_2: Save your brains and gas up another!
PHATBEET_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Phat Beet has been known to drop sick rhymes, dope grooves, and highly satisfactory jams, often within seconds of each other.
PHATBEET_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Phat Beets thump out damage every second.
PHATBEET_TOOLTIP: Thumps out damage every few seconds
PICKLEDPEPPER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}Pickled Pepper used to be a mildly successful comic at a social club called the Comedy Cannon, until one fateful night where a heckler pushed his buttons one too many times. Safe to say, the bottled up words thrown around were sour, heated, and even a little bit salty.
PICKLEDPEPPER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Pickled Peppers destroy an entire column of zombies.
PICKLEDPEPPER_TOOLTIP: Destroys an entire column of zombies
PINATA_HUNT_REFRESH_BODY: Spend gems to refresh all piñatas, or watch an advertisement to refresh one piñata.
PINATA_HUNT_TOOLTIP_DESCRIPTION: Replaying any world level awards a piñata from that world. Get more when the timer resets!
PINEAPPLE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}when attacked will get fat
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}Coming from a proud lineage of defensive pineapples, Puffapple worries about the pressure of not being able to live up to his Father's expectations when it comes to taking his place this high in the sky. He's a nervous eater, and with not much to eat here he's found himself chewing on the bullets of which are available in excess. But none of that stuff can be good for his health, and outside of hurting when crunching on their rough shells, he also worries about becoming fat as an aftermath. He's a bit of an eccentric plant, but very dependable when it comes to getting the job done.
PINEAPPLE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Puffapple can stop zombies from advancing and can deflect projectiles by puffing up.
PINEAPPLE_TOOLTIP: A flying wall that deflects ranged zombie attacks
PLANT_FOOD_TUTORIAL_1: Drag the Plant Food onto the plant
PLANT_FOOD_TUTORIAL_2: Use Plant Food to take out those zombies!
PLANT_FOOD_TUTORIAL_5:
Glowing green zombies carry Plant Food!
Collect that Plant Food the zombie dropped!
PLANT_HEALING_DESCRIPTION: Heal plants {PERCENT}%, up to {MAX}% of max health every {TIME} seconds!
PLAYERSEGMENT_TEST_13_DESC: quests_segment_1, quests_segment_4 (should fail, assert, crash, something)
PLAYERS_EPIC_QUEST_METEORZ: {PLAYER}'s Epic Quest - They Came to Meteor Z!
PLAYERS_EPIC_QUEST_RIFT: {PLAYER}'s Epic Quest - Hitchhiker's Guide to Time Travel!
PLAYERS_EPIC_QUEST_TTTB: {PLAYER}'s Epic Quest - They're Trying Their Best!
PLAY_LEVEL_OF_THE_DAY_DESC: Beat zombies, win seed packets and coins!
POISONPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}He's secretly just a normal Peashooter that discovered a new thing. A new thing that's turned into quite an obsession. The rest of the plants can't hear the end of it.
POISONPEASHOOTER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Goo Peashooters shoot poison peas at zombies, poisoning them.
POKRA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}spikes slow down zombies and pierce through armor

{FLAVOR}Pokra’s scrappy, she’s a fighter, she’s not afraid to jab below the belt to get the job done. She won’t, because that would be cheating, but she’s not afraid to. "Just so we’re clear," she says with a resolute glint in her eye.
POKRA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Pokras deliver piercing jabs that add up to a powerful spike launch that can pierce through armor, then they rest momentarily before starting again.
POPSMART: Have Market Box or Adept Flag increase speed of
POTATOCHIP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, explodes on contact

{FLAVOR}Potato Chip insists that it's important to go along with where life takes you. A bag, a tube, some kind of other thing? It's all life. "March on and keep a happy face," it says. Potato Chip, however, is not familiar with the terrifying concept of "crunch."
POTATOCHIP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Potato Chip crumbles upon contact, creating a small explosion that deals little damage.
POTATOCHIP_TOOLTIP: Explodes on contact, doing chip damage to a small area
POTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, delayed activation, explodes on contact

{FLAVOR}Believe it or not, SPUDOW! did not happen overnight. Having been forced to try out new catchphrases and focus testing as many variations as possible (Tubular? Really?), Potato Mine weeded out the competition to stick with what he knows best.
POTATOMINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Potato Mines explode on contact in a small area, but they take time to arm. Plant them ahead of zombies.
POTATOMINE_PLANTFOOD: Immediately arms itself, and launches out 3 armed clones to random tiles on the lawn.
POTATOMINE_TOOLTIP: Explodes on contact in a small area, but takes time to arm itself
POTIONSPEED1: Have Blue Vendor Zombie or Blue Candy from Jack-in-the-Box boost
POTIONSUPER1: Have Cardio Zombie or Spring's Choccy Milk boost
POTIONSUPER2: Have Super Brainz™ Energy Drink or Magenta Skull Zombie boost
POTIONTOUGHNESS1: Have ZCorp Egg Nog, Pink Vendor Zombie or Pink Candy from Jack-in-the-Box boost
POTIONTOUGHNESS2: Have Shamrock Shake or Attack Buff Tile boost
POTIONTOUGHNESS3: Have Brain Juice or Chief Hailstorm boost
POWERLILY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}creates one Plant Food

{FLAVOR}From seedling to sapling, to full grown foliage, Power Lily's experience as a life coach has shown her the best way to empower and support plants everywhere.
POWERLILY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Power Lilies create one Plant Food out of thin air.
POWERLILY_TOOLTIP: Creates one Plant Food for use
POWERPLANT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}DJ Tile Turnip changed dance floors with his underground hit "Turnip the Beet." What's his latest mix? When he lays it down, you'll feel the power.
POWERPLANT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Tile Turnips create a Power Tile on planting.
POWERTILE_TUTORIAL_1: Put Plant Food on a Peashooter
POWERTILE_TUTORIAL_3: Awesome! You can plant anything on Power Tiles
POWERUP_BEGHOULED_SHOVEL_DESCRIPTION: Use Power Shovel in Beghouled to remove plants and fill in craters!
POWERUP_BEGHOULED_SHUFFLE_DESCRIPTION: Use Power Shuffle in Beghouled to shuffle plants for more matches!
POWERUP_CANNON_DESCRIPTION: Tap and target a zombie with powerful cannon blasts in Assault Airspace!
POWERUP_FLAMETHROWER_DESCRIPTION: Hold your finger down to thaw ice and burn zombies in Frostbite Caves!
POWERUP_FLICK_DESCRIPTION: Swipe a zombie to toss it around. Swipe it twice to send it off the screen!
POWERUP_PINCH_DESCRIPTION: Pinch a zombie to destroy it!
POWERUP_SNOWBALL_DESCRIPTION: Hold your finger down on a zombie to throw chilling snowballs at it!
POWERUP_VASEBREAKER_BUTTER_DESCRIPTION: Tap to butter a single zombie in Vasebreaker!
POWERUP_VASEBREAKER_BUTTER_UNLOCK: Complete Egyptian Challenge Pack to unlock.
POWERUP_VASEBREAKER_MOVE_DESCRIPTION: Tap to select a vase, tap again to relocate to an empty tile in Vasebreaker!
POWERUP_VASEBREAKER_MOVE_UNLOCK: Complete Wave {ENDLESS_WAVE} in Endless to unlock.
POWERUP_VASEBREAKER_REVEAL_DESCRIPTION: Tap to reveal the contents of one vase in Vasebreaker!
POWERUP_WIZARDFINGER_DESCRIPTION: Hold your finger down on a zombie to electrocute it!
POWERVINE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}Power Vines horizontally or vertically adjacent to other Power Vines form a network
{FLAVOR}Power Vine's noodly antennae tremble in electric anticipation and he grins, imagining firing laser bolts at zombies in tandem with his brothers.
POWERVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Power Vines shoot rapid-fire, high-velocity laser bolts, and can increase their firepower by connecting up in a network.
PP_LOCKED_PROMPT_INFO: Zomboss kidnapped Dave! Penny's Pursuit levels use fuel but each level has perks that make it easier to play! Defeat enough levels for a chance to challenge Zomboss and save Dave!
PREMIUM_PLANT_QUEST_DESC: Take a premium plant out for a spin and earn rewards while doing it!
PREMIUM_PLANT_QUEST_TITLE: Try a Premium Plant for Free!
PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_LEVEL_NAME: Premium Quest - Big Beach Brawl! - Step {LEVEL_NUMBER}
PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_STEP_11_TITLE: Save a familiar set of endangered plants, don't let any trash come ashore!
PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_STEP_12_TITLE: Shark week was sooo last week! Take down Dr. Zomboss' sketchy sub once more!
PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_STEP_1_TITLE: Dip back into the beach with a flock of quacky fiends crashing the bash!
PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_STEP_2_TITLE: Tired of tanky armor and annoying surfboards? Game the system with Acid Lemon to put the squeeze on them!
PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_STEP_3_TITLE: A problem that can rival a zombie invasion... pollution! Help clean the seas!
PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_STEP_4_TITLE: Those beached up Imps are rock and rollin', but not as much as the bulbs bowling!
PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_STEP_5_TITLE: Help these zombies break out of their shells... by force!
PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_STEP_6_TITLE: Take it slow to defeat an amount of zombies in one fell swoop!
PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_STEP_7_TITLE: Shells come in many shapes and sizes. Unfortunately, these snap back like a crab!
PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_STEP_8_TITLE: Plan your defense without helpful aquatic and flying plants!
PREMIUM_QUEST_BEACH_STEP_9_TITLE: The pollution is getting worse.. now there's mold in the water!
PREREQ_TEST_01_DESC: Whitelist - Player must have Kiwibeast - award Kiwibeast seed Packet
PREREQ_TEST_02_DESC: Blacklist - Player must not have Hurrikale - award Hurrikale seed packets
